additional_WRITTEN_density_control_at_ST.scope: ONLY proper scalar Laplace-scale mixtures with finite positive scale B almost surely; NOT every generic two-fold framework/first-family or arbitrary multivariate extension
additional_WRITTEN_density_control_at_ST.statement_and_complete_proof: Write U=1/B>0 and f(x)=E[U*exp(-U*abs(x))]/2. For0<x<y, the integrand U*(exp(-Ux)-exp(-Uy)) is strictly positive almost surely; both expectations are finite since U*exp(-Ux)<=1/x. Hence f(x)>f(y). Thus this exact scalarLaplace instantiation cannot have a positive-width flat staircase plateau on x>0. This is consistent with approximate/near-optimal claims and does not refute the paper or preclude other base families/limits. It prevents a mistaken identification of MGF universality for the mixing variable with exact coverage of ALL output-density shapes.
